anywhere.title: From anywhere
anywhere.intro: Found an organization that hires? Send it to joblist from the page you are on: joblist finds its job board and fills in the form, you check and save.
anywhere.share.title: From your phone
anywhere.share.text: Install joblist: in your browser's menu, choose Install app or Add to Home screen. Then on an organization website, a job board or a job ad, tap Share and choose joblist.
anywhere.bookmarklet.title: From your computer
anywhere.bookmarklet.text: Drag this button to your bookmarks bar. On an organization website, a job board or a job page, click the bookmark: joblist opens on it, to see what it knows, save it or suggest it.
anywhere.bookmarklet.help: Drag it to your bookmarks bar; clicking it here does nothing.
anywhere.bookmarklet.code.help: Or make a new bookmark and paste this as its address.
anywhere.agents.title: For AI assistants
anywhere.agents.text: In browsers with WebMCP, an AI assistant can search organizations, jobs and lists here, and fill in the add form for you to check and save.
home.title: Organizations that hire, chosen by people
home.intro: Lists of organizations by city or field, made by anyone with a Bluesky account: each one shows its organizations' open jobs.
home.heading: Find work that feels right
home.lead: Open jobs read straight from organizations' own job boards. Nothing in between: you apply where they hire.

apps.firefox.text: On any website, the joblist button says:
apps.firefox.known: whether the organization is on joblist, and how many jobs it has open;
apps.firefox.links: the job board it links to, and its social profiles;

apps.firefox.step4: Pin the joblist button from the puzzle-piece menu, then click it on any website.
apps.firefox.temporary: Firefox removes a temporary add-on when it restarts: load it again the same way. Once it is on addons.mozilla.org, it will install in one click and stay.
